full_judgment:
2. The short facts leading to the disposal of the rule is that the opposite party Nos. 1-3 as plaintiffs tiled Title Suit No. 438 of 2009 before the learned Joint District Judge, 1st Court, Dhaka against the petitioners as defendants for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession. The case of the plaintiff is that the original owner of the suit land was Admond Alekgender William and his name was duly recorded in C.S. khatian No. 73 and he sold that property to one Abdul Latif and he took over the property over the suit land and he died leaving behind two sons and two daughters and the predecessors of the plaintiffs Rezia khatun got Ka schedule of property by amicable settlement and she gifted schedule land to her son plaintiff Mr. Rafique Ahmed, predecessor of the plaintiffs and transferred the possession of the plaintiffs and transferred the possession of the suit land and subsequently the defendants dispossessed the plaintiffs from the floor of the suit land and claimed the suit property, hence filed the suit. 

 4. The case of defendants is that Rezia Khatun, wife of Daliluddin transferred .07 acres of land in favour of Daliluddin on 07.05.1959 vide deed No. 5267 and on the same day Rezia Khatun transferred .04 acres of land in favour of Daliluddin vide deed No. 5266. Daliluddin owning and possessing that .11 acres of land transferred .07 acres of land in favour of Abdul Kader, Abdul Malek and Ekramul on 10.09.1960 vide deed No. 11676 and on the same day Daliluddin transferred .04 acres of land in favour of Abdul Kader, Abdul Malek and Fkramul vide deed o. 11677. Abdul Kader, Abdul Malek and Ekramul transferred 2 katha 13 Chatak land in favour of Kazi Obaidul Islam on 11.01.1961 and on the same day they transferred 2 katha 7 chatak land in favour of Sharifunnesa. Kazi Obaidul Islam and Shari funnesa sold their land to Wahiduddin Wara on 10.04.1965. Wahiduddin Wara mutated his name, paid rent to the Government and municipal holding and this Wahiduddin Wara transferred the land to his wife Rabea Khatun by registered sale deed on 31.11.1969 and Rabea Khatun owning and possessing the same by mutating her name transferred the land to Akter Banu, mother of the opposite party Nos. 1, 2 and 3. Akter Banu mutated his name both in Government Seresta and Dhaka City Corporation and paid electricity, gas bill etc. Akter Banu for construction of multistoried building over the suit land i.e. holding No. 9 of Eskaton Road submitted plan and after investigation that was approved by the RAJUK on 25.09.1979 and construction 3 storied building and possessing the same through Bharatia. In present city survey khatian, the land was correctly recorded in the name of Akter banu in plot No. 5265. Akter Banu had been in peaceful possession and died leaving behind one son and two daughters i.e. defendant Nos. 1-3. On 01.09.2008, the father of the defendant Nos. 1-3 made an agreement with BRAC Bank for letting out the suit premises for 10 years and the name of the building is "SHANAZ TOWER", 9, Eskaton road and the suit land with 3 storied building has been possessed by defendant Nos. 1-3 through Bharatia. The plaintiffs never possess the suit land.
